definitions.explanation: the function or act of reheating bath water that has cooled down, a common feature in Japanese bathrooms

examples.japanese: ⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|さ}めた→冷める：02114_sameru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{追|お}い{焚|だ}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The water got cold, so I'll reheat it.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{追|お}い→追う：02016_ou⟧ (additional) + {焚|だ}き (heating, burning) → additional heating
{追|お}い{焚|だ}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to reheat bath water)

JAPANESE BATH CULTURE:
In Japan, families often share the same bath water, with each person bathing one after another. The {追|お}い{焚|だ}き function reheats the water so later bathers can enjoy a warm bath without refilling.
